name: Notify GM after checking self life of items daily
script:
import frappe from datetime import datetime, timedelta APPROVED_KEYWORD = "Approved" THRESHOLD_PERCENT = 60 today = frappe.utils.today() alerts = [] # Get items with shelf life items = frappe.get_all( "Item", filters={ "shelf_life_in_days": [">", 0], "disabled": 0 }, fields=["name", "item_name", "shelf_life_in_days"] ) for item in items: # Get batches in Approved warehouses batches = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT b.name, b.expiry_date, sle.warehouse, SUM(sle.actual_qty) qty FROM `tabBatch` b JOIN `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle ON sle.batch_no = b.name WHERE sle.item_code = %s AND sle.warehouse LIKE %s GROUP BY b.name, sle.warehouse HAVING qty > 0 """, (item.name, f"%{APPROVED_KEYWORD}%"), as_dict=True) for batch in batches: if not batch.expiry_date: continue total_life = item.shelf_life_in_days days_left = frappe.utils.date_diff(batch.expiry_date, today) used_percent = (1 - (days_left / total_life)) * 100 if used_percent >= THRESHOLD_PERCENT: alerts.append({ "item": item.name, "warehouse": batch.warehouse, "batch": batch.name, "used": round(used_percent,2), "expiry": batch.expiry_date }) # Send notification if any alerts if alerts: rows = [] for a in alerts: rows.append(f""" {a['item']} {a['batch']} {a['warehouse']} {a['used']}% {a['expiry']} """) table = f""" {''.join(rows)}
Item Batch Warehouse Life Used Expiry
""" users = frappe.get_all( "Has Role", filters={"role": "General Manager"}, pluck="parent" ) for user in users: frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "Notification Log", "subject": "Shelf Life Alert (60% Consumed)", "email_content": table, "for_user": user, "type": "Alert" }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

name: Block Stock Entry When Material Transfer from Under Test store
Validate Work Order for Manufacturing Batch
Create or Assign Manufacturing Batch In Work Order
script:
# =========================
# FIX 1: AUTO FETCH PRODUCT TYPE FROM BOM
# =========================
if doc.bom_no:
    product_type = frappe.db.get_value("BOM", doc.bom_no, "custom_product_type")
    
    if product_type:
        doc.custom_product_type = product_type
        frappe.msgprint(f"Product Type Set: {product_type}")
    else:
        frappe.msgprint("Product Type NOT found in BOM")

# =========================
# FIX 2: DEFAULT BATCH OPTION
# =========================
if not doc.custom_batch_option:
    doc.custom_batch_option = "Create New Batch"

# =========================================================
# FIX 3: CREATE / LINK MANUFACTURING BATCH (PRODUCTION SAFE)
# =========================================================

# =========================================================
# CASE 1: SEMI-FINISHED → CREATE BATCH
# =========================================================
if doc.custom_product_type == "Semi-Finished" and not doc.custom_manufacturing_batch:

    date_str = frappe.utils.nowdate()
    month = date_str[5:7]
    year = date_str[2:4]

    prefix = "BS"

    last = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT batch_number FROM `tabManufacturing Batch` WHERE batch_number LIKE %s ORDER BY creation DESC LIMIT 1",
        (prefix + month + year + "%",)
    )

    if last:
        number = int(last[0][0][-3:]) + 1
    else:
        number = 1

    batch_no = prefix + month + year + str(number).zfill(3)

    batch = frappe.new_doc("Manufacturing Batch")

    batch.batch_number = batch_no
    batch.fg_batch = batch_no
    batch.semi_fg_batch = batch_no + "-S"

    # ---------- SET SFG ----------
    batch.semi_finished_item = doc.production_item

    # ---------- FIND FG USING REVERSE BOM ----------
    fg_bom = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT parent 
        FROM `tabBOM Item`
        WHERE item_code = %s
        LIMIT 1
    """, (doc.production_item,), as_dict=1)

    if not fg_bom:
        frappe.throw("FG BOM not found for SFG item: " + doc.production_item)

    fg_item = frappe.db.get_value("BOM", fg_bom[0]["parent"], "item")

    if not fg_item:
        frappe.throw("FG Item not found")

    batch.finished_item = fg_item

    # ---------- INSERT ----------
    batch.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    doc.custom_manufacturing_batch = batch.batch_number

    # ---------- CREATE ERP BATCH ----------
    if not frappe.db.exists("Batch", batch_no):
        fg_batch = frappe.new_doc("Batch")
        fg_batch.batch_id = batch_no
        fg_batch.item = batch.finished_item
        fg_batch.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    if not frappe.db.exists("Batch", batch_no + "-S"):
        sfg_batch = frappe.new_doc("Batch")
        sfg_batch.batch_id = batch_no + "-S"
        sfg_batch.item = batch.semi_finished_item
        sfg_batch.insert(ignore_permissions=True)


# =========================================================
# CASE 2: FINISHED → LINK EXISTING BATCH
# =========================================================
elif doc.custom_product_type == "Finished" and not doc.custom_manufacturing_batch:

    # Find SFG item from BOM
    bom_items = frappe.get_all(
        "BOM Item",
        filters={"parent": doc.bom_no},
        fields=["item_code"]
    )

    sfg_item = None
    for item in bom_items:
        item_group = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item["item_code"], "item_group")
        if item_group == "Sub Assembly Goods":
            sfg_item = item["item_code"]
            break

    if not sfg_item:
        frappe.throw("No Semi-Finished item found in BOM")

    # Find latest batch
    batch = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT batch_number
        FROM `tabManufacturing Batch`
        WHERE semi_finished_item = %s
        ORDER BY creation DESC
        LIMIT 1
    """, (sfg_item,), as_dict=1)

    if not batch:
        frappe.throw("No Manufacturing Batch found. Create Semi-Finished first.")

    doc.custom_manufacturing_batch = batch[0]["batch_number"]
    
    
    
# =========================
# EXISTING LOGIC (KEEP)
# =========================
if doc.custom_batch_option == "Select Semi-Finished Batch":

    fg_batch = doc.custom_linked_batch.replace("-S", "")
    doc.custom_manufacturing_batch = fg_batch


if doc.custom_batch_option == "Select Finished Batch":

    doc.custom_manufacturing_batch = doc.custom_linked_batch


# =========================================================
# FETCH BATCH DATA
# =========================================================

if doc.custom_manufacturing_batch:

    batch_data = frappe.get_all(
        "Manufacturing Batch",
        filters={"batch_number": doc.custom_manufacturing_batch},
        fields=["fg_batch", "semi_fg_batch", "finished_item", "semi_finished_item"],
        limit=1
    )

    if not batch_data:
        frappe.throw("Manufacturing Batch not found")

    batch = batch_data[0]


    # =========================================================
    # VALIDATION 1: SEMI-FG DUPLICATE PREVENTION
    # =========================================================
    if doc.production_item == batch["semi_finished_item"]:
        
        
        result = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sle.actual_qty), 0)
            FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
            INNER JOIN `tabSerial and Batch Entry` sbe
                ON sbe.parent = sle.serial_and_batch_bundle
            WHERE sle.item_code = %s
                AND sbe.batch_no = %s
                AND sle.docstatus = 1
            """, (batch["semi_finished_item"], batch["semi_fg_batch"]))

        stock_qty = result[0][0] if result else 0

        if stock_qty > 0:
            frappe.throw("Semi-FG already exists for batch " + batch["semi_fg_batch"])

        existing_wo = frappe.db.exists("Work Order", {
            "name": ["!=", doc.name],
            "production_item": batch["semi_finished_item"],
            "custom_manufacturing_batch": doc.custom_manufacturing_batch,
            "docstatus": ["!=", 2]
        })

        if existing_wo:
            frappe.throw("Semi-FG Work Order already exists for batch " + batch["semi_fg_batch"])


    # =========================================================
    # VALIDATION 2: FG WITHOUT SEMI-FG PREVENTION (FIXED)
    # =========================================================
    if doc.production_item == batch["finished_item"] and doc.custom_product_type == "Finished":
        
        result = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sle.actual_qty), 0)
            FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
            INNER JOIN `tabSerial and Batch Entry` sbe
                ON sbe.parent = sle.serial_and_batch_bundle
            WHERE sle.item_code = %s
                AND sbe.batch_no = %s

    for d in doc.items:

            sfg_warehouse = d.s_warehouse
            break


    # =========================
    # SAFETY CHECK: Prevent FG before Semi-FG
    # =========================
    if batch.semi_finished_item:

        qty = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sle.actual_qty), 0)
            FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
            INNER JOIN `tabSerial and Batch Entry` sbe
                ON sbe.parent = sle.serial_and_batch_bundle
            WHERE sle.item_code = %s
                AND sbe.batch_no = %s

        # Check ONLY when FG is being produced

            if item.is_finished_item and item.item_code == batch.finished_item:

                    
                if qty <= 0:
                    frappe.throw(
                        f"Semi-FG must be produced before FG.\nBatch: {batch.semi_fg_batch}"
                    )

                # OPTIONAL STRICT CHECK
                if qty < item.qty:
                    frappe.throw(
                        f"Not enough Semi-FG stock. Available: {qty}, Required: {item.qty}"
                    )        

    # =========================
    # BATCH ASSIGNMENT
    # =========================
    for item in doc.items:

        if item.is_finished_item:

            if item.item_code == batch.finished_item:

if doc.purpose == "Manufacture" and doc.work_order:

    wo = frappe.get_doc("Work Order", doc.work_order)
    
    
    # Run ONLY for Semi FG
    if wo.custom_product_type == "Semi-Finished":
        
        
           # Find Finished Item row
        fg_item = None
        for item in doc.items:
            if item.is_finished_item:
                fg_item = item
                break
        
        if not fg_item:
            frappe.throw("Semi FG item not found in Stock Entry")
            
        if not fg_item.batch_no:
        
            # -------------------------
            # 1. Create Prefix
            # -------------------------
            date_str = frappe.utils.nowdate()
            month = date_str[5:7]
            year = date_str[0:4]
        
            prefix = f"BS{month}{year}"   # BS042026
        
            # -------------------------
            # 2. Get Last Batch
            # -------------------------
            last_batch = frappe.db.sql(f"""
                SELECT batch_id
                FROM `tabBatch`
                WHERE batch_id LIKE '{prefix}%'
                ORDER BY batch_id DESC
                LIMIT 1
            """, as_dict=True)
        
            if last_batch:
                last_no = last_batch[0].batch_id
        
                # Extract number part
                number_part = last_no.replace(prefix, "").replace("-S", "")
                next_number = int(number_part) + 1
            else:
                next_number = 1
        
            # -------------------------
            # 3. Format Batch Number
            # -------------------------
            batch_no = f"{prefix}{str(next_number).zfill(5)}-S"
            
            # -------------------------
            # 4. Create Batch
            # -------------------------
            if not frappe.db.exists("Batch", batch_no):
        
                sfg_batch = frappe.new_doc("Batch")
                sfg_batch.batch_id = batch_no
                sfg_batch.item = fg_item.item_code
                sfg_batch.manufacturing_date = date_str
                sfg_batch.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        
            # -------------------------
            # 5. Assign to Item (IMPORTANT)

            item.batch_no = batch_no
            
            for d in doc.items:

            # bundle.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            
            # frappe.throw(f" SEMmmmI FG Batch {item.item_code} {item.batch_no} ")
            
            # item.serial_and_batch_bundle = bundle.name
            
            # Update Work Order
            frappe.db.set_value("Work Order", doc.work_order, {
                "custom_final_batch": batch_no
                #"custom_batch_qty": qty,
            })
            
            doc.custom_final_batch=batch_no;
    
    
    
    

    # Run ONLY for FG
    if wo.custom_product_type == "Finished":
        
        item_doc = frappe.get_doc("Item", wo.production_item)
        
        batch = wo.custom_source_semi_fg_batch
        
        if not batch:
            frappe.throw("Please select SEMI FG batch")
            
          

        # -------------------------
        # 1. VALIDATE BATCH
        # -------------------------
        if not batch.endswith("-S"):

        if frappe.db.get_value("Batch", batch, "custom_is_consumed"):
            frappe.throw("Batch already consumed")

        
         

        # -------------------------

        for d in doc.items:
            if d.is_finished_item:
                fg_item = d
                break

        if not fg_item:
            frappe.throw("FG item not found in Stock Entry")
            
         
        #frappe.throw(f"FG fg_item {fg_item} ")   
        # -------------------------

script:

Skip fully paid # if doc.outstanding_amount <= 0: # continue for row in doc.payment_schedule: # Skip if nothing pending in this schedule row if not row.outstanding or row.outstanding <= 0: continue due_date = frappe.utils.getdate(row.due_date) days_diff = (due_date - today_date).days # ====================== # REMINDER LOGIC # ====================== reminder_type = None # if days_diff == 2: # reminder_type = "First Reminder" # elif days_diff == 0: # reminder_type = "Second Reminder" # elif days_diff == -2: # reminder_type = "Third Reminder" # elif days_diff == -7: # reminder_type = "Fourth Reminder" # elif days_diff < -7 and abs(days_diff) % 15 == 0: # reminder_type = "Continuous Follow-up" if days_diff in [2, 1, 0, -1, -2, -7]: reminder_type = "Test Reminder" if not reminder_type: continue frappe.log_error( f"{doc.name} | Due: {row.due_date} | Days Diff: {days_diff}", "DEBUG-DAYS" ) # ====================== # DUPLICATE CHECK # ====================== if doc.custom_last_reminder_date: last_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.custom_last_reminder_date) if last_date == today_date: continue # ====================== # GET RECIPIENTS # ====================== recipients = [] # Customer Email customer_email = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.customer, "email_id") if customer_email: recipients.append(customer_email) # Sales Persons via Delivery Note for item in doc.items: if item.delivery_note: try: dn_doc = frappe.get_doc("Delivery Note", item.delivery_note) for sp in dn_doc.sales_team: # Try Sales Person email sp_email = frappe.db.get_value("Sales Person", sp.sales_person, "email_id") # fallback via User if not sp_email: sp_email = frappe.db.get_value("User", sp.sales_person, "email") if sp_email: recipients.append(sp_email) except Exception as e: frappe.log_error(str(e), "DN Fetch Error") # Remove duplicates recipients = list(set(recipients)) frappe.log_error(f"Recipients: {recipients}", "DEBUG-EMAIL") if not recipients: frappe.log_error(f"No recipients for {doc.name}", "DEBUG") continue # ====================== # GENERATE PDF # ====================== try: pdf = frappe.get_print( "Sales Invoice", doc.name, print_format="Sales Invoice Print Custom", # CHANGE THIS as_pdf=True ) except Exception as e: frappe.log_error(str(e), "PDF Error") continue # Outstanding Amount: {row.outstanding}

Please make payment at the earliest.

Thank you.

name: Weekly off doctype date validatation
Weekly off Calculation Salary Slip
script:
employee = frappe.get_doc("Employee", doc.employee)

# Default entitlement = 4
entitlement = employee.weekly_off_entitlement or 4

# Count Weekly Off Attendance
weekly_off_taken = frappe.db.count(
    "Attendance",
    {
        "employee": doc.employee,
        "is_weekly_off": 1,
        "attendance_date": ["between", [doc.start_date, doc.end_date]]
    }
)

# Balance Weekly Off
balance = entitlement - weekly_off_taken

if balance < 0:
    balance = 0

# Update fields
doc.weekly_off_taken = weekly_off_taken
doc.weekly_off_balance = balance
